name: Reverse String
instructions:
# Instructions

Your task is to reverse a given string.

Some examples:

- Turn `"stressed"` into `"desserts"`.
- Turn `"strops"` into `"sports"`.
- Turn `"racecar"` into `"racecar"`.
introduction:
# Introduction

Reversing strings (reading them from right to left, rather than from left to right) is a surprisingly common task in programming.

For example, in bioinformatics, reversing the sequence of DNA or RNA strings is often important for various analyses, such as finding complementary strands or identifying palindromic sequences that have biological significance.

example_solution:
Function Get-ReverseString {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
    Reverse a string

    .DESCRIPTION
    Reverses the string in its entirety. That is it does not reverse each word in a string individually.

    .PARAMETER Forward
    The string to be reversed

    .EXAMPLE
    Get-ReverseString "PowerShell"
    
    This will return llehSrewoP

    .EXAMPLE
    Get-ReverseString "racecar"

    This will return racecar as it is a palindrome
    #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    Param(
        [Parameter(Position=1, ValueFromPipeline=$true)]
        [string]$Forward
    )
    $textElements = [Globalization.StringInfo]::GetTextElementEnumerator($Forward)
    $graphemes = [Collections.Generic.List[String]]::new()
    while ($textElements.MoveNext()) {
        $graphemes.Insert(0, $textElements.GetTextElement())
    }
    -join $graphemes
}
